question.text: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

exchange.sent: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits as a communications-device test block for LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi UE validation, not as the radar echo, radar-target, EMC, or EME test block in the radar workflow. [37]
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow area | Where Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Communications link / UE validation | Use signaling test for UAV LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling test and de-sense validation. [37] | [37] |
| R&D / callbox-style verification | CMX500 Callbox is positioned to quickly establish DUT connection and perform RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN / cellular desense, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D verification. [13] | [13] |
| Test phase placement | CMX500 Callbox places Go-NoGo Testing, Non-Sig Testing, Conformance Testing, and R&D Testing in its testing-phase context. [15] | [15] |
| Example non-signaling / RF checks | CMX500 Callbox example use cases include sensitivity testing, de-sense testing, 3GPP pre-conformance testing, SRS RF measurements, UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification. [71] | [71] |
| Production-style non-signaling RF testing | For WLAN device production, RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and CMP180 is positioned for that purpose. [81] | [81] |
| Radar-specific workflow | Radar echo generation is covered by radar echo / artificial object generation capabilities such as AREG800A dynamic artificial object generation, not by signaling / non-signaling tester passages. [29] | [29] |
| EMC / EME workflow | UAV / drone EMC and EME testing focuses on EMC, EMI, EMS, EME, radiated / conducted layout, and system-level effects testing, and the knowledge base explicitly says not to infer CMX500 signaling options as EMC / EME test systems. [37] | [37] |
### 推論
【推論】In an Aerospace / Defense radar program, place Signaling / Non-signaling Tester after or alongside radar and EMC / EME testing only when the radar platform also has LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi communications that need UE, RF, desense, pre-conformance, or non-signaling verification. [37][13][71]
【推論】Do not position Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the radar-target simulator or radar echo generator, because the radar passages identify AREG800A-style dynamic artificial object / echo generation for radar, while the signaling passages identify LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi communications testing. [29][37]

[[2025RS Drone Solution]] 說 [[MIL-STD-464]] provides the basis of environment testing for vehicles that have to work in the most unforgiving condition，並將其描述為 system level testing standard。

來源列出的 main chapter / sub-items 包含：

- margins，6 dB margins。
- intra-system EMC。
- hull generated intermodulation interference / IMI。
- shipboard internal EME。
- multipaction。
- induced levels at antenna ports of antenna-connected receivers。
- external RF EME。
- [[High Power Microwave]] / HPM sources。
- lightning。
- [[Electromagnetic Pulse]] / EMP。
- subsystems and equipment electromagnetic interference / EMI。
- portable electronics devices and carry-on equipment requirements。
- non-developmental items / NDI and commercial items。
- electrostatic environments。
- radiation hazards / RADHAZ：HERP、HERF、HERO。
- life cycle / E3 hardness。
- electrical bonding、power current return path、antenna installations、mechanical interfaces、shock / fault / ignitable vapour protection。
- external grounds。
- TEMPEST。
- system radiated emission、EMCON、platform radiated emission。
- EM spectrum supportability。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility
來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing
[[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] 是 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 中引用 [[RTCA DO-160]] 作為 airborne equipment environmental conditions and test procedures 的測試線索，用於 military / aviation drone EMC proposal context。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 22 — Lightning Induced Transients
來源說此測試確保 equipment can withstand a selection of fast transients intended to represent induced effects of lightning，並在頁面標題中列 [[CS117]]。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › toolchain
來源列出的 CMX500 toolchain 包含：

- [[R&S CMsquares]]。
- [[R&S CONTEST]]。
- Conformance：LTE、NR、2G、3G、C-IoT。
- 測試範圍：RF Conformance、RRM、LBS、NetOp、PCT、signaling tests、application、callbox、NPT、PQA、3GPP RF preconformance、ATE。
- 相關設備：[[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S ATS CATR]]、[[R&S NGM200]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing
[[CMX500 use-case based 5G testing]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 market / solution positioning：以 use-case based approach 支援 5G eMBB、FWA、RedCap、NTN、XR 等裝置測試，而不只是一組單點工具。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › Shuffler
來源描述 [[Shuffler]]：

- RF / T-put test on all supported UE band combos in one go。
- All Shuffler tests part of [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] test package。
- Loop blocks provide flexibility to loop through bands、bandwidth、channels。
- one test script with one test report can test RF TX / RX measurement、RX sensitivity measurement、throughput、VoLTE / VoNR。
- Band combinations input via UE capabilities or user-defined Excel sheet。
- Shuffler implemented in [[R&S CMsequencer]]。

此處仍需正式 [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] 文件補證。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes › 重點摘要
- [[MVG]]（Microwave Vision Group）已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- 來源稱此整合讓使用者可直接使用 [[MVG]] antenna measurement systems 執行 [[5G NR]] 與 [[LTE]] [[OTA testing]] signaling tests。
- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 被描述為支援 full stack generation and analysis of 4G、[[5G NR]]、[[WLAN]] 與 [[LTE]] signals。
- 與 [[MVG]] multi-probe measurement systems 搭配時，來源稱可在 real-world conditions 下進行 precise OTA testing。
- [[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 整合後，來源稱 [[MVG]] systems 可處理 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）mode、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]（FDD & TDD）signaling testing。
- 來源稱整合支援 multiple hardware configurations of the [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]，包括 `CMX Lite` 與 `CMX Pro`；但未提供正式料號、BOM 或與既有 [[R&S CMX500]] standard hardware configurations 的對照。
- 來源列出可支援的標準 / 場景包括 [[5G NR FR1]] SA、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]。
- 來源稱此整合可移除 earlier setups 的複雜度，減少 preparation and measurements 所需時間，並加速 development cycles。
- [[Pierre Jurek]] 以 [[MVG]] Chief Commercial Officer 身分表示，MVG 決定支援 different OBT configurations，並正快速擴充測試能力到 WiFi technologies，尤其是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]。
- [[Christoph Pointner]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers 身分表示，[[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 multi-band capabilities 可顯著簡化 OTA test setup。
- Press & media contact 為 [[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 公司資訊：2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue EUR 3.16 billion；2025-06-30 員工超過 15,000 人。
- [[MVG]] 公司資訊：Microwave Vision Group 提供 electromagnetic waves visualization 技術、antenna characterization、radar signature evaluation 與 electromagnetic measurements 測試方案；營運於 10 個國家，90% sales from exports，revenues exceeding €100 million。

- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality，可讓 R&D engineers 以 single instrument setup 測試 cellular 與 non-cellular standards。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

- [[R&S CMP180]] 來源說法：two analyzers、two generators、two sets of eight RF ports integrated，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing；兩台 CMP180 可 combined / scaled，支援 four analyzers and generators，用於 4x4 MIMO access points。

- 公司段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，且 2025-06-30 有 more than 15,000 employees worldwide。

[[mx844030pc-j1200]] 將 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 描述為 software protocol simulator / Virtual Signalling Test Solution，透過虛擬化 protocol stack，在 PC 上重現多個 protocol layers：

- [[RRC-NAS]]
- [[PDCP]]
- [[RLC]]
- [[MAC]]

來源主張它可不使用一般硬體測試儀而在 PC 上快速建立 protocol test environment；但 RF-IF configuration 仍使用 [[Anritsu MD8190A]] Universal RF Unit 與 [[MX819020A]] RF Platform。

[[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 則是 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 中 Anritsu NR / RedCap protocol simulation and test product / solution 語彙。兩者名稱相近，但目前沒有來源支持它們是同一產品、同一架構或同一市場分類。

- Workflow steps 包含 overview measurement、data reduction、maximization、adjustment、final measurement。
- Virtual RMS detectors with **100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth** 可把 lower bandwidth measurement integration over 100 MHz / 200 MHz sliding window，用於平行量測 -13 dBm/MHz 與 -10 dBm/100 MHz limits。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

### Short answer
Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits as a communications-device test block for LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi UE validation, not as the radar echo, radar-target, EMC, or EME test block in the radar workflow. [37]
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow area | Where Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Communications link / UE validation | Use signaling test for UAV LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling test and de-sense validation. [37] | [37] |
| R&D / callbox-style verification | CMX500 Callbox is positioned to quickly establish DUT connection and perform RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN / cellular desense, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D verification. [13] | [13] |
| Test phase placement | CMX500 Callbox places Go-NoGo Testing, Non-Sig Testing, Conformance Testing, and R&D Testing in its testing-phase context. [15] | [15] |
| Example non-signaling / RF checks | CMX500 Callbox example use cases include sensitivity testing, de-sense testing, 3GPP pre-conformance testing, SRS RF measurements, UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification. [71] | [71] |
| Production-style non-signaling RF testing | For WLAN device production, RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and CMP180 is positioned for that purpose. [81] | [81] |
| Radar-specific workflow | Radar echo generation is covered by radar echo / artificial object generation capabilities such as AREG800A dynamic artificial object generation, not by signaling / non-signaling tester passages. [29] | [29] |
| EMC / EME workflow | UAV / drone EMC and EME testing focuses on EMC, EMI, EMS, EME, radiated / conducted layout, and system-level effects testing, and the knowledge base explicitly says not to infer CMX500 signaling options as EMC / EME test systems. [37] | [37] |
### 推論
【推論】In an Aerospace / Defense radar program, place Signaling / Non-signaling Tester after or alongside radar and EMC / EME testing only when the radar platform also has LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi communications that need UE, RF, desense, pre-conformance, or non-signaling verification. [37][13][71]
【推論】Do not position Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the radar-target simulator or radar echo generator, because the radar passages identify AREG800A-style dynamic artificial object / echo generation for radar, while the signaling passages identify LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi communications testing. [29][37]

- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality，可讓 R&D engineers 以 single instrument setup 測試 cellular 與 non-cellular standards。

### Short answer
Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits as a communications-device test block for LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi UE validation, not as the radar echo, radar-target, EMC, or EME test block in the radar workflow. [37]
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow area | Where Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Communications link / UE validation | Use signaling test for UAV LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling test and de-sense validation. [37] | [37] |
| R&D / callbox-style verification | CMX500 Callbox is positioned to quickly establish DUT connection and perform RF, mobility, application, NTN, WLAN / cellular desense, pre-conformance, and non-signaling R&D verification. [13] | [13] |
| Test phase placement | CMX500 Callbox places Go-NoGo Testing, Non-Sig Testing, Conformance Testing, and R&D Testing in its testing-phase context. [15] | [15] |
| Example non-signaling / RF checks | CMX500 Callbox example use cases include sensitivity testing, de-sense testing, 3GPP pre-conformance testing, SRS RF measurements, UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification. [71] | [71] |
| Production-style non-signaling RF testing | For WLAN device production, RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and CMP180 is positioned for that purpose. [81] | [81] |
| Radar-specific workflow | Radar echo generation is covered by radar echo / artificial object generation capabilities such as AREG800A dynamic artificial object generation, not by signaling / non-signaling tester passages. [29] | [29] |
| EMC / EME workflow | UAV / drone EMC and EME testing focuses on EMC, EMI, EMS, EME, radiated / conducted layout, and system-level effects testing, and the knowledge base explicitly says not to infer CMX500 signaling options as EMC / EME test systems. [37] | [37] |
### 推論
【推論】In an Aerospace / Defense radar program, place Signaling / Non-signaling Tester after or alongside radar and EMC / EME testing only when the radar platform also has LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi communications that need UE, RF, desense, pre-conformance, or non-signaling verification. [37][13][71]
【推論】Do not position Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the radar-target simulator or radar echo generator, because the radar passages identify AREG800A-style dynamic artificial object / echo generation for radar, while the signaling passages identify LTE / 5G / Wi‑Fi communications testing. [29][37]

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions › 與 signaling test 的區分
- [[UAV signaling test solution]] 依 [[Signaling test solution]] 聚焦 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 UAV [[LTE]]、[[5G]]、[[Wi-Fi]] UE 的 signaling test 與 De-sense validation。
- [[UAV UAS Drones T&M Solutions]] 依 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 聚焦 [[EMC]]、[[EMI]]、[[EMS]]、[[EME]]、radiated / conducted layout 與 system-level effects test。

兩者可同屬 drone test solution 線索，但不可把 CMX500 signaling option 自動推論為 EMC / EME test system，也不可把 EMC 系統推論為 cellular / WLAN protocol tester。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。
